title: Using Green Sciences and Regenerative Practices in Beauty Innovation
summary: Agatha Relota Luczo of Furtuna Skin and Erin Zoller of L’Oréal discussed sustainability, regenerative farming and how green sciences lead to innovation with Pam Alabaster, adjunct professor at Columbia.
